text: Connection comes before teaching. Learning happens naturally only when children feel safe, seen, heard and loved. With 30 years of experience in early years education, I have seen how trust, play and shared experiences build the relationships every child needs. We listen and observe before we guide, design every corner so children can choose and explore, and document learning to understand how each child thinks and where their curiosity will lead next.
affirmation: “I am heard. I am loved. I am trusted. I am capable. I am believed in.” Every child at Ananya Tots.
